title: ChannelMontageReference
description: Channel set, montage, and reference scheme for one analysis. Guards against silent channel-count assumptions and normative extrapolation across densities.

electrode_density.description: Used to enforce: 19ch normative data must NOT be extrapolated to 64ch.

hardcoded_channels.description: Channels an estimator hardcodes (e.g. O1/O2/F3/F4). Recorded so montage mismatches surface instead of silently mis-mapping.

normative_extrapolation_allowed.description: Structural guard: normative comparison across differing electrode_density is forbidden.
